skeeto/w64devkit.body:
* New command: `zip` (Info-ZIP compatible, from [tugz](https://github.com/skeeto/tugz))
  * `gzip`, `gunzip`, `zcat`, and `unzip` replaced with tugz
* New command: `make2compdb` (JSON Compilation Database) [#392]
* GDB Unicode improvements
  * Correct `OutputDebugStringW` display (Windows 10 and later)
  * TUI displays UTF-8 text
* Shell history limit raised to 16k entries, default 1k
* Upgrade to GDB 18.1
* Upgrade to Ccache 4.14.1
* Upgrade to CMake 4.4.4
* Upgrade to NSIS 3.13
* Upgrade to Quilt.cpp 0.69.3

Releases are self-extracting 7-zip archives, also extractable with any 7z-capable utility (e.g. 7zr.exe). The "x86" release is compatible with Windows XP but requires at least a Pentium 4 processor (SSE2).
